title: A shopping agent called the same search URL again and again
summary: A recorded run of the bundled shopping agent a22 called open_url with the identical 4K-monitor search URL more than three times in a row and ended with an empty answer. T5-009 reports a retry storm on open_url. A recorded run of the same task that calls that URL once and then stops passes the same check.

target.description: The bundled shopping agent a22, case 1, judged from its recorded OpenTelemetry trace (Failure Lab 004).
target.version: the a22 traces that ship with agentest-ai 3.8.0 and this repository
target.scope_note: A teaching example about one recorded run. It is not a claim about how often agents fail, and it is not a verdict on a framework or a model.

reproduce.judge: agentest std run --otlp examples/failure-lab/004-search-url-retry/traces/original.otlp.jsonl --card agents/a22/agent-card.json --tools agents/a22/tools.json --ids T5-009
